shifts.description: Configure shift requirements, duty roles, leaderboards, and quotas.

enableShifts.description: This unlocks the ability for staff to use a shifts system, where they can get on-duty, off-duty, take a break and see their total duty time.

onDutyRole.description: Role given to users when they are on-duty. This is optional, but recommended to easily identify who is on-duty.

dutyTypes.description: The types of duty a staff member can select when going on-duty.

minShiftDuration.description: A minimum shift duration for a shift to count towards their duty time. Default is 0, which means all shift time counts.

enableLeaderboard.description: If enabled, staff can see a leaderboard of who has the most duty time in the configured timeframe.

leaderboardLookback.description: The timeframe of the duty time shown on the leaderboard.

enableQuotas.description: If enabled, you can set a custom quota of hours for staff to meet in the configured timeframe.

quotaTimeframe.description: The timeframe in which the quota must be met.

quotas.description: Set required hours per role - the left side will be the role, and the right side is a number which is the hours for the quota. The user's highest role counts as their quota.

logShiftChanges.description: When enabled, shift changes (such as going on-duty, on break, or off-duty) will be logged in a custom channel.

logShiftChangesChannel.description: The channel where shift changes will be logged. You can set this empty to use the general log channel.

status.description: Configure Leave of Absence (LoA) and Reduced Activity (RA) settings.

enableStatusSystem.description: Enabling this unlocks the Leave of Absence (LoA) and Reduced Activity (RA) system, allowing staff to request these statuses and have them tracked.

enableLoa.description: If enabled, staff can request a Leave of Absence (LoA).

loaRole.description: Role given to users when they are on a Leave of Absence. This is optional, but recommended to easily identify who is on LoA.

loaMaxDays.description: The maximum duration for a Leave of Absence in days. This limits how long staff can request to be on LoA for.

requireLoaApproval.description: If enabled, LoA requests will require approval from staff who have supervisor permissions or higher.

enableRa.description: If enabled, staff can request Reduced Activity (RA) status for when they are still working but at a reduced load.

raRole.description: Role given to users when they are on Reduced Activity. This is optional, but recommended to easily identify who is on RA.

raMaxDays.description: The maximum duration for RA in days. This limits how long staff can request to be on RA for.

requireRaApproval.description: If enabled, RA requests will require approval from staff who have supervisor permissions or higher.

statusLogChannel.description: Channel where requests are sent for approval.

logStatusChanges.description: If enabled, any changes in staff status (going on/off LoA or RA) will be logged in the configured channel.

statusChangeLogChannel.description: Channel where status changes are logged. By default this uses your main log channel, but you can set a separate channel here.

profiles.description: Configure the staff profile system (Intros, custom nicknames, and stats).

enableProfiles.description: Allows staff to have a profile tracking their shifts, reviews, and a custom introduction.

onlyAllowStaffProfile.humanName: Only allow staff and higher to have their own customizable profile
onlyAllowStaffProfile.description: If enabled, only staff members and higher will be able to set a custom profile nickname and introduction. If disabled, all members will be able to set a custom profile nickname and introduction.

managePermission.description: Which group is allowed to forcibly wipe another staff member's profile?

profileEmbedMessage.description: Customize the embed shown when viewing a staff profile.

nickname.description: The user's custom profile nickname (uses default username if not set).

status.description: The user's current status (LoA, RA, etc.).

activity-checks.description: Configure automated staff activity checks and response logging.

enableActivityChecks.description: Allows admins to start an activity check to see who is active.

targetRoles.description: The roles required to respond to the activity check. Anyone with these roles will be expected to click the button. Leave empty to default to the General Staff Roles.

timeframe.description: How long staff have to respond to the activity check (Max 168 hours / 1 week).

checkMessage.description: The message sent when an activity check starts.

default.title: 📋 Staff Activity Check
default.description: Please click the button below to confirm your activity before %endtime%.

end-time.description: The Discord timestamp when the check ends.

sendingChannel.description: The default channel where the activity check message will be posted. This can manually be overridden with the command.

exceptionsType.description: Who are excused from the activity checks?

customExceptionRoles.description: Only applies if 'Custom role(s)' is selected above.

automatedChecks.description: If enabled, the bot will automatically start activity checks at configured intervals.

automatedCheckInterval.description: On which interval to start automatic checks. Choose cronjob for full customzation.

automatedCheckCronjob.description: The cronjob schedule for automatic checks. Only applies if 'Cronjob' is selected above.

automatedCheckWeekDay.description: The week day to start automatic checks.

automatedCheckMonthWeek.description: The week of the month to start automatic checks. Only applies if 'Monthly' is selected above.

logChannel.description: Where the final results are posted. Leave empty if you want to use the general log channel.

pingResults.description: Ping specific roles when the results are posted.

pingRoles.description: The roles to ping with the results message.
